title: Longest runtimes: @Joe Weinberg   #theatre #broadway  #westend #arts ...
transcript: Here's an updated ranking of the top 5 shortest theatre performances I've ever seen based on run time. I did this video just last year, but the ranking has changed significantly since then. I saw a lot of short theatre this year. I also did one for the longest run times, but that hasn't really changed. Two quick notes before I start: First of all, we're going by the run time of the whole bill. So if a short play is tacked on to a longer play and you buy one ticket, or if it's like an evening of 10 minute one acts performed back to back, that doesn't count. I've also seen several short interactive theatre pieces without live performers, and I didn't include those either. In fifth place, Prelude, which I just saw a few days ago, it's an outdoor performance by Charles Mee, directed by Ann Bogart, with songs by the Lazours, and this one clocked in at a breezy 34 minutes long. Next I have this Italian show from the Edinburgh Fringe called The Gummy Bears Great War, and this one was only about 30 minutes and I believe just under 30 minutes was End of Days by Niall Harris and Dyer Rhodes, which was performed at the Whitney Museum this summer. And before I give you the top two, go ahead and tell me in the comments what's the shortest run time of a show you've seen on its own standalone bill. in 2nd place is another play that I saw just in the last week. This is Caryl Churchill's short play Triumph, which is at the Public Theatre, and the performance I attended clocked in at 22 minutes long. But still undefeated in 1st place was a performance that Bill Irwin did outdoors back in 2020. It was called The Busking Project and it was an impressively short 9 minutes long, making it easily the shortest standalone theatrical performance I've ever seen.
classificationReason: A personal ranking of 5 shortest theatre runtimes the creator has experienced (Prelude, The Gummy Bears Great War, End of Days, etc.). List format with 3+ shows, none of which appear on the provided list.
